tool_args.rationale: The history gap and transient lag support a coupled memory state. Reconstructing that state from the irregular prefixes and fitting all four ODE parameters gives a training RMSE of about 9e-6 and leave-one-out errors below 4e-5 across horizons spanning H=0.45. These are checks on paid data, not fresh confirmation; submit the model for that test.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed targets stay positive for both signs of the input step, which a single signed step-response amplitude cannot reproduce.
The recalled law depends only on the current input and horizon, so it cannot represent the observed history gap at matched endpoints.
The eight paid trajectories already constrain the coupled model near the target horizon; fresh confirmation is more informative than another training probe.
